missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Отдел' is the nominative subject of 'работает'. 'Наш' agrees in the masculine, and 'очень хорошо' evaluates the work.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'В большом отделе' uses the prepositional form 'отделе' after 'в' to mark a workplace. 'Большом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Отдел' is the inanimate masculine accusative object of 'создал', matching the nominative form. 'Новый' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Отдела' is genitive, expressing the head of which unit. A standard noun-plus-genitive structure for relationships.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Отдел' is the accusative after 'в' to mark movement into a place. 'Другой' agrees in the masculine accusative, marking a transfer.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Отделу' is the dative after 'к', expressing approach. 'Нашему' agrees in the masculine dative, a natural office movement.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'руководить'. 'Отделом' is the instrumental required by the verb 'руководит'. 'Продаж' is genitive plural specifying which department.

missions.phrase: Без отдела кадров здесь не обойтись.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive after 'без'. 'Отдела' is genitive following 'без' to express absence. 'Кадров' is genitive plural naming the kind of department.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Отделы' is the nominative plural subject of 'работают'. 'Разные' agrees in the plural, describing the variety of departments.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'О новых отделах' uses the prepositional plural after 'о' to mark the topic of conversation. 'Новых' agrees in the plural.
